summary: Frontend-only testing completed for LOTR 5e Travel System. All 9 requested features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: JourneyMiniMap component correctly displays route with thick brown line visible even on large maps (Hobbiton to Minas Tirith)
Origin marker (green) and destination marker (red) with location names displayed clearly on map
Terrain breakdown shows colored progress bars: Fácil (green), Moderado (yellow), Difícil (orange), Muy Difícil (red)
Roads used badges correctly display multiple roads: Camino del Este, Camino a Isengard, Gran camino del Oeste, etc.
PX breakdown shows complete info: Vía (camino real), Base (10 PX/casilla), Bonus terreno (+5 PX/casilla), Multiplicador (x1.25)
Travel mode tabs correctly switch between 'Viaje Global' and 'Jornada a Jornada' with button text updating
Warning message disappears after Guide role is assigned
Vacant role badges update correctly when roles are assigned
context_for_next_testing_agent: All travel system features verified working after the reported fixes. Map route line is now thick and visible, terrain breakdown with progress bars works correctly, PX breakdown shows all values including bonus and multiplier.

F1_map_shows_route.description: Map displays visible brown route line between origin and destination
F1_map_shows_route.evidence: Tested Hobbiton to Bree and Hobbiton to Minas Tirith routes - brown line clearly visible with thicker stroke

F2_origin_destination_markers.description: Origin marker (green) and destination marker (red) displayed with location names
F2_origin_destination_markers.evidence: Map shows large green circle at Hobbiton, large red circle at destination, with labels and legend

F3_terrain_breakdown_progress_bars.description: Desglose del Terreno section with colored progress bars
F3_terrain_breakdown_progress_bars.evidence: Shows Fácil (226.5km green), Moderado (144.4km yellow), Difícil (55.4km orange), Muy Difícil (34.7km red)

F4_roads_used_badges.description: Caminos utilizados section shows road badges
F4_roads_used_badges.evidence: Displays badges: Camino del Este, Camino a Isengard, Gran camino del Oeste, Viejo Camino del Sur, Camino Verde

F5_px_breakdown.description: Desglose PX with type, base, bonus, and multiplier
F5_px_breakdown.evidence: Shows Vía: camino real, Base: 10 PX/casilla, Bonus terreno: +5 PX/casilla, Multiplicador: x1.25

F6_travel_mode_tabs.description: Tabs for Global vs Jornada a Jornada modes
F6_travel_mode_tabs.evidence: Modo de Viaje section shows both tabs that correctly switch active state

F7_guide_warning.description: Warning displayed when no Guide assigned
F7_guide_warning.evidence: Orange warning banner: 'No hay ningún Guía asignado. Se requiere al menos uno para iniciar el viaje.'

F8_vacant_role_badges.evidence: Shows badges: Guía Vacante, Cazador Vacante, Vigía Vacante, Explorador Vacante - updates when roles assigned

F9_character_selector.description: Character dropdown selector for each role
F9_character_selector.evidence: Dropdown shows characters with modifier badges (+1, +2), selection updates role card and removes warning

route_calculation_long.note: PX is 0 for Tierras Libres which is correct per the PX table

ui_quality.map_visibility: Route line now thick enough to be visible on large scale maps
ui_quality.markers: Large colored markers with glow effect and text labels
ui_quality.styling: Consistent parchment-style cards with gold accents
ui_quality.responsiveness: All elements visible and functional at 1920x1080
